document.shortDescription: Wednesday after-school theater classes in SoHo for ages 3-6 at Freshmade NYC.
document.longDescription:
Treasure Trunk Theatre's official SoHo page lists its Imagination Adventure class at Freshmade NYC, 636 Broadway Suite 516 in SoHo. The official page publishes a Spring Session for ages 3-6 on Wednesdays from 3:30 PM to 4:15 PM, with registration handled through Sawyer.

The class description emphasizes acting, movement, storytelling, props, costumes, and improvisation, making this a strong theater listing for preschool-age children. Treasure Trunk Theatre's official contact page lists phone (347) 762-9475.

Sources: https://www.treasuretrunktheatre.com/soho2/ https://www.treasuretrunktheatre.com/contact/ https://www.treasuretrunktheatre.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/Screen-Shot-2016-04-28-at-4.40.36-PM.png
